description:
If you're wondering why everything seems so ordinary all of a sudden, it's because you've just walked into the kitchen.

You can make out an opened fridge. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You can make out an oven. You can't wait to tell the folks at home about this! However, the stove, like an empty stove, has nothing on it. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it!
